environment.fixtures: Synthetic 1x1 PNG and isolated JSON canvas records

history.beforeFixReproduction: Deleting a history entry removed an output image still referenced by a canvas: HTTP 200 to 404.
history.afterFixCanvasReference: History entry removed; canvas-referenced output image stayed HTTP 200.
history.afterFixUnreferenced: History entry removed; unreferenced output image changed HTTP 200 to 404.
history.afterFixInput: Input image stayed HTTP 200 after its history entry was removed.

assetItem.source: Original generated image stayed HTTP 200 with identical SHA-256.
assetItem.additionalRegression: Canvas-referenced library copy stays on disk; an index entry pointing directly to generated output cannot delete the source.

category.beforeFixReproduction: Deleting a category removed its library copy despite a canvas reference: HTTP 200 to 404; category directory removed.
category.afterFix: Category index removed; referenced library copy stayed HTTP 200 and its nonempty directory stayed on disk. Unreferenced copy and empty directory are removed.

project.result: Project index removed; response moved=1. Canvas JSON stayed on disk, project changed to default, media URL and source HTTP 200 remained.

pageReadback.result: After clicking category delete twice in the asset manager, ordinary canvas rendered an output image element. Browser reported complete=true, naturalWidth=32, naturalHeight=32 and the retained library URL.

visiblePageActions.project: Selected F11 test project, clicked Delete and its page confirmation. Project disappeared and its canvas appeared under Default; persisted canvas project=default.
visiblePageActions.assetItem: Selected F11 item category and clicked the item detail Delete button. UI showed '素材已删除'; item and unreferenced copy disappeared while source remained HTTP 200.
visiblePageActions.category: Selected F11 category, clicked Delete and then Confirm Delete. Category disappeared; another canvas still loaded its referenced 32x32 library image (HTTP 200).
visiblePageActions.history: Opened zimage history Manage, selected its sole synthetic card, clicked Delete Selected and accepted the browser confirm. Card disappeared; history record was removed and canvas image stayed HTTP 200.

verification: 43 Python unittest cases, py_compile, and git diff --check passed, including batch deletion reference protection.
limits: Only local synthetic PNG and isolated ordinary canvas records were exercised. Other media types, production data, and provider-backed content remain unverified.
